item.title: Understanding The PIC Architecture
item.description: In last post we defined the basic learning path and working method and defined a basic structure for our uplifter code but due to lack of knowledge about architecture we needed to break the work there. So, I’m here with new post where we’ll try to closely follow the learning path. Don’t worry, you don’t need to switch back and forth between posts to compare whether I’m following the order or not.
